name: Leopold and Astrid Coast Flowline 2
name_zh: Leopold and Astrid Coast流域流线 2
description_en: Representative 2 km flowline for the Leopold and Astrid Coast basin, spanning about 596 km from the inland catchment to the floating terminus.
description_zh: 基于原始 BedMachine 与冰流速场提取的 Leopold and Astrid Coast流域 代表性 2 km 流线，沿程约 596 公里，连接内陆汇流区与下游浮动末端。

region_info.name_zh: Leopold and Astrid Coast流域流线 2
region_info.location: East Antarctica, Leopold and Astrid Coast basin
key_facts_en: Peak observed flow speed along the line is about 722 m/yr.
Minimum bed elevation reaches -984 m and maximum ice thickness reaches 3396 m.
The extracted line includes a floating shelf section near the downstream end.
key_facts_zh: 沿线最大观测流速约为每年 722 米。
最低基岩高程约为 -984 米，最大冰厚约为 3396 米。
这条流线在下游末端包含浮冰架段。
